headline: Six Aeta Passengers Dead, Three Missing After Mapanuepe Lake Boat Capsize
seoTitle: 6 Dead in Mapanuepe Lake Boat Capsize | FMB News
seoDescription: Six Aeta passengers died, four survived and three remained missing after a motorboat carrying 13 people capsized in Mapanuepe Lake, Zambales.
deck: Responders searched for three missing passengers after a motorboat carrying 13 members of an Aeta community capsized near the Sunken Church in Barangay Buhawen.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Six members of an Aeta community died, four survived and three remained missing after a motorboat carrying 13 passengers capsized in Mapanuepe Lake in San Marcelino, Zambales, authorities said.
The incident occurred on Thursday afternoon, August 27, near the Sunken Church in Barangay Buhawen. The Philippine Coast Guard said the fatalities included three adults and three minors.

sections.heading: Search for the missing
paragraphs: The Coast Guard joined municipal disaster personnel, police and other responders in searching for the missing passengers. Underwater and surface operations were repeatedly disrupted on Friday by worsening weather and were suspended again in the afternoon.
Authorities said the missing passengers included an adult and two children. FMB News is withholding unnecessary personal details while the search continues.

sections.heading: What authorities know
paragraphs: The passengers were members of an Aeta community in Sitio Lumibao and were returning from Barangay Buhawen after receiving food and medicine and attending a vaccination program, according to the Coast Guard.

Initial accounts indicated that the motorboat encountered strong winds and rough water before capsizing. The Coast Guard said the circumstances remained under investigation, so the precise cause has not been established.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The accident occurred as the Southwest Monsoon brought persistent rain and unsettled conditions to Zambales. Residents of Sitio Lumibao rely on boats to cross Mapanuepe Lake to reach the main part of Barangay Buhawen.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: The tragedy highlights the risks faced by communities that depend on small boats during rapidly changing monsoon conditions and the need for timely local weather and water-safety guidance.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Authorities are expected to resume search operations when conditions permit and continue investigating the circumstances of the capsize.
